question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**intensify**" means to become or make more intense. (तीव्र होना)
 
• In the context of meteorology, "intensify" is commonly used to describe the strengthening of a weather system, such as a depression turning into a cyclonic storm.
 
• The other options: "**manipulate**," "**plus**," and "**derive**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** The deep depression over the west-central Bay of Bengal is likely to **intensify**__ into a cyclonic storm by November 17 morning, said Uma Shankar Das, senior scientist in India Meteorological Department's Bhubaneswar regional centre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipulate (हेरफेर करना)**: means to control or influence cleverly or unscrupulously.
 
• **Plus (अतिरिक्त)**: means an additional amount or degree.
 
• **Derive (प्राप्त करना)**: means to obtain something from a specified source.
